description: [Commercial Transit / Mobility] PHASE 2/3 (API): Confirms a booking against a hold_id (preferred) or directly against offer_id if partner allows. Does not collect card PANs — accepts opaque payment_ref or principal_consent_token from calling agent. On success returns order_id / voucher references. If API book is unavailable, returns structured fallback to deep_link.

hold_id.description: Hold id returned by geo360_hold_offer (preferred path)

idempotency_key.description: Caller-generated key to safely retry book without double purchase

offer_id.description: Required if partner supports direct book without hold, or for reconciliation

payment_ref.description: Opaque payment handle from agent/payment rail — never raw card data

principal_consent_token.description: Opaque token proving the human principal authorized this book within limits

travelers.description: Minimal traveler data required by partner

name: geo360_book_offer
